findings.evidence: Closing customers should combine the opening, new, and churned customers from the same month. H9 is the sole break in the otherwise consistent C9:Z9 pattern: G9 is =G5+G6+G7 and I9 is =I5+I6+I7, but H9 incorrectly uses prior-period opening customers (G5) rather than H5. This understates H9 by 248 customers and propagates through all subsequent customer, revenue, EBITDA, and valuation periods. Recalculation with =H5+H6+H7 raises total EBITDA in P&L!AA15 from 13,284,673 to 13,877,705 and enterprise value in Valuation!B7 from 112,458,006 to 118,389,455.
